India_Feb\u201926_CPI_rises_to_3_21%_yet.title: India Feb CPI inflation rises to 3.21 percent
India_Feb\u201926_CPI_rises_to_3_21%_yet.summary: India's inflation rate rose to 3.21% in February. This matters for India's economy as it may impact growth and stability.
commentary: Feb'26 CPI inflation rose to 3.21%, driven by sharp increase in food inflation to 3.35%. Core inflation stayed subdued at 1.9%.
India_Feb\u201926_CPI_rises_to_3_21%_yet.quantis_view: The upside surprise in Feb'26 CPI may exert pressure on interest rates, though the subdued core inflation and expected muted food inflation in FY26 may limit the downside for bonds and support select consumer staples stocks.

WPI-Inflation_Mar-2026.pdf.title: WPI Inflation Hits 11-Month High
WPI-Inflation_Mar-2026.pdf.summary: India's inflation rose to 11-month high. This matters for India's economy as it may impact growth.
commentary: WPI at 11-month high: 2.13% YoY in Feb, up from 1.8% in Jan. Food inflation rose 1.85% YoY. Fuel inflation up 1.17% MoM, driven by LPG and mineral oil prices.
WPI-Inflation_Mar-2026.pdf.quantis_view: Rising WPI and food inflation may exert upside pressure on interest rates, posing downside risk to rate-sensitive sectors, while crude oil price volatility may add to inflationary concerns.

DAM Capital - Iran War Sector IMpact.pdf.summary: A war in Iran may disrupt global energy supplies. This matters for India's economy as it may increase the country's deficit and inflation.
commentary: Iran war affects global oil, gas, and helium supplies. Gulf supplies 20% of world's LNG, 1/3 of helium, and 45% of sulphur. India's deficit may rise by Rs 100bn with every $1 increase in crude oil price, affecting fertilizers and inflation.
DAM Capital - Iran War Sector IMpact.pdf.quantis_view: The Iran war signals upside pressure on energy prices, potentially triggering rate cuts, with the energy sector set to benefit, while fertilizer, aluminium, and methanol producers may face downside risks due to disrupted supply chains.

Indian_Paints_Sector_Channel_checks_10_0.title: Indian Paints Sector Sees Pricing Upside Amid Volatile Crude
Indian_Paints_Sector_Channel_checks_10_0.summary: India's paint sector may see price hikes due to high crude oil costs. This matters for India's economy as stable demand and potential price increases could impact the sector's growth.
commentary: Crude oil prices up 10-12% in 5 days. Paint dealers expect 2-5% price hikes in April if prices sustain. Demand remains stable with mid-single digit growth.
Indian_Paints_Sector_Channel_checks_10_0.quantis_view: Volatile crude prices may exert upside pressure on Indian paint stocks, with potential low-single digit price hikes in 1Q27, although downside risk to margins remains, particularly if crude sustains at elevated levels.

The Digital-First Bank\u2019s Guide to A.title: AI Investment in Banks to Hit $97 Billion
The Digital-First Bank\u2019s Guide to A.summary: Banks are investing heavily in AI for better services. This matters for India's economy as it upgrades the banking sector.
commentary: $35 billion invested in AI by financial institutions in 1 year, expected to reach $97 billion by 2027.
The Digital-First Bank\u2019s Guide to A.quantis_view: The data signals upside for tech and fintech stocks, with potential upside pressure on interest rates as $97b in AI investments by 2027 may lead to increased efficiency and reduced labor costs in the financial sector.
